May 21st, 2001 I got busted for possession of marijuana. That night, my folks bailed me out, and a lot of bad stuff happened that isn't important. The story as far as we're concerned starts when I decided to die. I stole my mom's huge 90 day prescription, figuring that it would probably do the job fairly quickly and that it would be irreversible.
I went to the bathroom, poured the pills into my mouth and got a double handful of water and chased em on down. After about five minutes, I got really hot and kind of confused. I could tell that I was gone already, but it just got worse. About minute 20, my breathing had slowed down enough to where I was seeing large black blobs in my vision and could barely stand up. Around 25 or 30 minutes into it, EMS got there.
By that time I couldn't even stand and by then my breathing had slowed down to about 5 breaths a minute. The last thing I remember before I lost consciousness was the EMT telling me not to close my eyes. By that time I knew I was a goner, and the panic associated with knowing Im dying had left me. I was calm, a bit sad and scared, but I could feel the pull of those drugs. I woke up to hear the ER doctor tell one of the nurses that 'we'll have him out of here in 15 minutes if he's still alive by then.' The only real lasting physical effect was slight kidney damage. I can't drink colas on a regular basis anymore or anything like that.
